mapper.sql: O.ORDER_ID, O.MEMBER_ID, O.ORDER_DT, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.TOTAL_AMT, O.CLOSE_YN

when.test: dateRange != null and dateRange.from != null and dateRange.to != null

mapper.select:
SELECT /*+ INDEX(O IX_ORDER_01) */ , M.MEMBER_NM, M.GRADE_CD, NVL(C.CODE_NM, '미정') AS STATUS_NM FROM TB_ORDER O, TB_MEMBER M, TB_CODE C WHERE O.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID AND O.ORDER_STATUS = C.CODE(+) AND C.GROUP_CD(+) = 'ORDER_STATUS' /* 예전 조건: AND O.ORDER_ID IN (SELECT ORDER_ID FROM TB_ORDER_BAK) */
ORDER BY ${sortColumn}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ORDER O, TB_MEMBER M WHERE O.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID

SELECT , M.MEMBER_NM, M.GRADE_CD, I.ITEM_SEQ, I.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NM, I.QTY, I.UNIT_PRICE, I.AMT FROM TB_ORDER O INNER JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = O.MEMBER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ORDER_ITEM I ON I.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = I.PRODUCT_ID WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} ORDER BY I.ITEM_SEQ

SELECT I.ORDER_ID, I.ITEM_SEQ, I.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NM, I.QTY, I.UNIT_PRICE, I.AMT, DECODE(P.STATUS_CD, 'SALE', '판매중', 'STOP', '판매중지', '기타') AS PRODUCT_STATUS_NM, (SELECT MAX(H.CHG_DT) FROM TB_ORDER_HIST H WHERE H.ORDER_ID = I.ORDER_ID) AS LAST_CHG_DT FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM I JOIN TB_PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = I.PRODUCT_ID WHERE I.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} ORDER BY I.ITEM_SEQ
mapper.insert:
INSERT ALL
INTO TB_ORDER_ITEM (ORDER_ID, ITEM_SEQ, PRODUCT_ID, QTY, UNIT_PRICE, AMT) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{idx} + 1, #{item.productId}, #{item.qty}, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.amt})
SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_ORDER WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_PAYMENT P WHERE P.ORDER_ID = TB_ORDER.ORDER_ID AND P.PAY_STATUS = 'DONE')
mapper.select: SELECT T.ORDER_STATUS, FN_GET_CODE_NM('ORDER_STATUS', T.ORDER_STATUS) AS STATUS_NM, SUM(T.CNT) AS CNT FROM (SELECT O.ORDER_STATUS, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_ORDER O WHERE O.ORDER_DT >= #{fromDt} GROUP BY O.ORDER_STATUS UNION ALL SELECT H.ORDER_STATUS, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_ORDER_HIST H WHERE H.CHG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{fromDt}, 'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY H.ORDER_STATUS ) T GROUP BY T.ORDER_STATUS ORDER BY T.ORDER_STATUS
